functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.chat_admin_media_object_path(p_workspace uuid, p_character uuid, p_asset uuid, p_kind text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select p_workspace::text||'/'||p_character::text||'/'||p_asset::text||case p_kind when 'image' then '.webp' when 'video' then '.mp4' else null end
$function$

functions.name: chat_admin_media_price_rules_valid
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.chat_admin_media_price_rules_valid(value jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_typeof(value)='object'
 and value ?& array['negotiation_allowed','special_discounts_allowed']
 and (value-array['negotiation_allowed','special_discounts_allowed'])='{}'::jsonb
 and jsonb_typeof(value->'negotiation_allowed')='boolean'
 and jsonb_typeof(value->'special_discounts_allowed')='boolean'
$function$

functions.name: chat_admin_media_revision
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.chat_admin_media_revision()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if TG_OP='UPDATE' then new.revision:=old.revision+1; end if;
 update public.chat_characters set revision=revision+1,updated_at=now()
 where workspace_id=case when TG_OP='DELETE' then old.workspace_id else new.workspace_id end
 and id=case when TG_OP='DELETE' then old.character_id else new.character_id end;
 if TG_OP='INSERT' and TG_TABLE_NAME='chat_character_media' and
 (select count(*) from public.chat_character_media m where m.workspace_id=new.workspace_id and m.character_id=new.character_id)>=100
 then raise exception 'media_library_limit'; end if;
 if TG_OP='DELETE' then return old; end if; return new;
end;$function$

functions.name: chat_admin_media_writes_allowed
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.chat_admin_media_writes_allowed(target_workspace uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select auth.uid() is not null and public.is_current_chat_admin_workspace(target_workspace)
 and not exists(select 1 from public.account_deletion_requests r where r.user_id=auth.uid() and r.status='processing')
$function$
